title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bates College
description: Discover the essential late-night food stops for Bates students, from on-campus staples like the Bobcat Den to local Lewiston favorites that stay open after hours.

cards.title: The Cereal Wall at Commons
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Study Fuel
cards.notes: Visit the massive cereal wall for a late-night snack during extended finals hours or before the doors close at 9:00 PM on weekdays.
cards.short_summary: The central dining hall at Bates, known for its single-hall community and iconic cereal selection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons is the primary dining hall where students gather late, featuring a well-known cereal wall and staying open until 9:00 PM Monday-Thursday.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation and Meal Prices | Dining, Conferences and Campus Events (DCCE)
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday through Thursday; hours vary on weekends and during breaks.

cards.title: Late Night at the Den
cards.subtitle: Chase Hall Social Hub
cards.notes: Order a Bates Burger or mozzarella sticks during designated late-night hours, typically on Wednesday nights until 11:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A retail dining space in Chase Hall that serves as a popular alternative to the main dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bobcat Den reopened for late-night hours on Wednesday nights until 11:00 PM to provide a mid-week social dining option.
cards.source_title: First Time in Four Years: Den Opens For Late-Night Option - The Bates Student
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours are currently limited to Wednesdays until 11:00 PM; check campus signage for seasonal updates.

cards.title: Kim's Kitchen
cards.subtitle: The Closest Off-Campus Run
cards.notes: Walk across Russell Street for fried rice or fries at this family-run convenience store, a staple for students living in nearby dorms.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood variety store and kitchen located directly across from the Bates campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Kim's Kitchen is a frequent late-night destination for Bates students, located on the corner of Bardwell and Russell Streets.
cards.source_title: More than just a Convenience Store: Meet the Owner of Kim's Kitchen - The Bates Student
cards.access_notes: Located at 88 Russell St; typically open until 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM on weekends.

cards.title: Lewiston House of Pizza
cards.subtitle: Midnight Pizza Delivery
cards.notes: Order a late-night pie or Greek specialty; they stay open until midnight on Friday and Saturday for delivery or pickup.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing local pizzeria known for Greek-style pizza and late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewiston House of Pizza is open until 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.source_title: Lewiston House of Pizza Lewiston Maine Restaurant Menu - MenusInLA
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday; closes at 10:00 PM on other nights.

cards.title: Sam's on Sabattus
cards.subtitle: Maine Italian Tradition
cards.notes: Grab a signature Maine Italian sandwich on a fresh-baked roll; the Sabattus Street location is open until midnight on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A regional chain famous for its specific style of Italian sandwiches and fresh rolls.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sam's Italian Foods location at 963 Sabattus St is open until 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday; 11:00 PM on Thursdays.

cards.title: The 24/7 Main Street Run
cards.subtitle: Always Open Convenience
cards.notes: Head to Main Street for 24-hour access to snacks, drinks, and quick bites when everything else in town is closed.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store located a short distance from the campus perimeter.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 345 Main St in Lewiston is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Dunkin' on Main
cards.subtitle: Late Coffee & Donuts
cards.notes: Fuel up with coffee or donuts until 9:00 PM at this Main Street location, a common stop for students heading back to campus.
cards.short_summary: A popular coffee and donut chain with multiple locations in Lewiston.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 420 Main St is open until 9:00 PM daily.

cards.title: DaVinci's in the Mill
cards.subtitle: Late Weekend Italian
cards.notes: Enjoy brick-oven pizza or garlic knots in the historic Bates Mill complex; they serve until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An Italian restaurant located in a refurbished textile mill, popular for its atmosphere and food.
cards.evidence_claim: DaVinci's Italian Eatery is open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.source_title: Reservations - DaVinci's Italian Eatery | Lewiston, Maine
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday; 9:00 PM on other nights.

cards.title: Governor's Late Night
cards.subtitle: Classic Maine Comfort
cards.notes: Visit for a late-night dessert or burger; this Maine staple is open until 9:00 PM on weekends for a sit-down meal.
cards.short_summary: A family-style restaurant and bakery known for its desserts and Maine-centric menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Governor's Restaurant in Lewiston is open until 9:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM on Friday and Saturday; 8:00 PM on other days.

cards.title: Forage Market
cards.subtitle: Early Morning Recovery
cards.notes: While not open late at night, Forage is the go-to morning-after spot for wood-fired bagels starting at 8:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A popular downtown market and bakery famous for its hand-rolled, wood-fired bagels.
cards.evidence_claim: Forage Market is a central part of the Bates student food culture, opening at 8:00 AM daily for breakfast.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
